cards.title: What this is
cards.body: A public-record accountability datacube intended to become civic infrastructure, not an accusation list.

cards.title: Current pilot
cards.body: DOJ SLS law-enforcement source inventory; useful for training source/status/custody gates, not the project boundary.

cards.title: Current hard phase
cards.body: No people, incidents, payload summaries, public status claims, canonical agencies, lawsuit merits, or settlement amounts are admitted yet.

cards.title: Permanent constraints
cards.body: Source-bound claims, due-process distinctions, civilian privacy, correction routes, and no public-record-to-public-display collapse.

cards.title: Phase-bound constraints
cards.body: No-person and DOJ-first rules are safety scaffolds, not eternal prohibitions.

cards.title: What to earn next
cards.body: Either continue preservation/fixity for DOJ sources, deepen the charter, or branch a new low-harm source family.

cards.title: How to dream
cards.body: Record ambitious futures as open horizon entries; gate them hard later.

cards.title: What not to forget
cards.body: The purpose is to make democratic memory durable enough that fragmentation no longer protects abuse or institutional failure.
